GATE EVIDENCE for the AC 'make lint, make typecheck and the FULL gating suite (make test) pass'.

Every change in this epic passed the gates twice - locally before push, and independently in CI as the Gerrit Verified vote. All four changes are MERGED on main and NONE could have merged without Verified +1, which IS the full CI suite.

Local runs, in the worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-serena-default:
- story C (06ae): make lint exit 0; make typecheck Success (381 source files); make test 7479 passed / 37 skipped / 0 failed in 28m16s.
- early-land regression check for the C+D prefix, cherry-picked onto the then-current origin/main (a1977fd48) in a throwaway worktree: make lint exit 0; make typecheck Success (389 source files); make test 7595 passed / 37 skipped / 0 failed in 27m52s.
- stories B + A together (84c7 + 4143) on the C-and-D-landed main: make lint exit 0; make typecheck Success (389 source files); make test 7665 passed / 29 skipped / 0 failed in 29m33s.
- An intermediate run FAILED honestly and was fixed rather than papered over: 7664 passed / 1 failed, tests/unit/test_project_portability_criterion.py::test_production_fan_in, because story B added a SECOND project criterion and that test copied only one rubric into its sandbox and asserted the project fan-in list by equality. Both were fixed inside story B's change; the next full run was clean (the 7665 above).
- Post-merge confirmation on the merged tip (36411da47): the three new test modules pass, 57 passed.

CI (the Verified gate, GitHub Actions 'Gerrit Verified Gate'):
- change 1016 (C): Verified +1, run 30507395547 SUCCESS.
- change 1017 (D): Verified +1, run 30507553947 SUCCESS.
- change 1024 (B): Verified +1 on patch set 1 (run 30513447785) and again on patch set 2 after the rubric amendment.
- change 1025 (A): Verified +1 on patch set 1 (run 30513449134) and again on patch set 2.

Each change also carries LLM-Review +1 with 0 unresolved comments; only the bots cast either label, so none of this is self-approved.
